iframe.title: lava
iframe.allow: fullscreen; autoplay; gamepad; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; web-share; accelerometer; gyroscope
iframe.srcdoc:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>lava</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Quicksand:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --coral: #ff7a68;
    --coral-deep: #e2434a;
    --red: #ef2f3d;
    --red-deep: #c81f2d;
    --orange: #ff8e2b;
    --orange-deep: #ff6b1a;
    --yellow: #ffd23f;
    --yellow-soft: #ffdf70;
    --cream: #fff1e6;
    --ink: #5c1616;
    --sidebar: #e8564f;
    --sidebar-deep: #7a2129;
  }

  *{ box-sizing: border-box; }

  html,body{
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    height:100%;
    font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif;
    overflow:hidden;
  }

  body{
    display:flex;
    background:var(--red);
    color:var(--cream);
  }

  .sidebar{
    position:relative;
    width:92px;
    flex-shrink:0;
    height:100vh;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    padding:22px 0 18px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, var(--sidebar) 0%, var(--sidebar-deep) 100%);
    box-shadow: 6px 0 24px rgba(60,10,14,0.35);
    z-index:20;
  }

  .nav-list{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:20px;
    width:100%;
    align-items:center;
    margin-top:6px;
  }

  .nav-item{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:5px;
    width:64px;
    padding:8px 4px 7px;
    border-radius:16px;
    color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
    text-decoration:none;
    font-size:11.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:.2px;
    transition: background .18s ease, color .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
    cursor:pointer;
    background:transparent;
    border:none;
  }

  .nav-item svg{ width:20px; height:20px; transition: transform .18s ease; }
  .nav-item:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color:#fff; transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .nav-item.active{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
    color:#fff;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  }

  .brand-tag{
    margin-top:auto;
    font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:500;
    color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    letter-spacing:.3px;
  }

  .stage{
    position:relative;
    flex:1;
    height:100vh;
    overflow:hidden;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--coral) 0%, var(--coral) 30%, var(--red) 68%, var(--red-deep) 100%);
  }

  .blob-layer{ position:absolute; inset:0; overflow:hidden; }
  .blob{ position:absolute; will-change: transform; }
  .blob svg{ display:block; width:100%; height:100%; }

  .b-yellow{ top:-8%; right:-18%; width:75%; height:60%; animation: driftYellow 26s ease-in-out infinite; filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 30px rgba(120,50,0,0.15)); }
  .b-orange{ bottom:8%; left:-20%; width:70%; height:55%; animation: driftOrange 22s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .b-shadow{ top:-15%; right:-15%; width:55%; height:45%; opacity:.35; animation: driftShadow 30s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .b-floor{ bottom:-25%; left:-10%; width:120%; height:55%; animation: driftFloor 34s ease-in-out infinite; }

  @keyframes driftYellow{ 0%,100%{ transform: translate(0,0) scale(1) rotate(0deg); } 50%{ transform: translate(-2.5%, 2%) scale(1.03) rotate(1.2deg); } }
  @keyframes driftOrange{ 0%,100%{ transform: translate(0,0) scale(1) rotate(0deg); } 50%{ transform: translate(3%, -2%) scale(1.04) rotate(-1.4deg); } }
  @keyframes driftShadow{ 0%,100%{ transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); } 50%{ transform: translate(-2%, 2%) scale(1.06); } }
  @keyframes driftFloor{ 0%,100%{ transform: translateX(0) scaleY(1); } 50%{ transform: translateX(1.5%) scaleY(1.04); } }

  .grain{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 3px 3px;
    opacity:.4;
    pointer-events:none;
  }

  .content{
    position:relative; z-index:10; height:100%;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    padding:0 24px; text-align:center;
  }

  .logo-wrap{ display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; margin-bottom:34px; animation: riseIn .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1) both; }
  .logo{ font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size:96px; font-weight:600; color:#fff; letter-spacing:-2px; text-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(90,10,10,0.35); line-height:1; user-select:none; }
  .logo-beta{ font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16); padding:4px 12px; border-radius:999px; transform: translateY(-8px); }

  @keyframes riseIn{ from{ opacity:0; transform: translateY(14px); } to{ opacity:1; transform: translateY(0); } }

  .search-form{ width:min(640px, 84vw); animation: riseIn .8s .08s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1) both; }
  .search-box{
    position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius:20px;
    padding:6px 8px 6px 22px; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(80,10,15,0.28), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    transition: box-shadow .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, background .2s ease;
  }
  .search-box:focus-within{ background:rgba(255,255,255,0.24); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(80,10,15,0.34), 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }
  .search-icon{ width:20px; height:20px; flex-shrink:0; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); }
  .search-input{ flex:1; border:none; outline:none; background:transparent; color:#fff; font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:18px; padding:12px 12px; }
  .search-input::placeholder{ color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65); font-weight:600; }
  .search-submit{ flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:14px; border:none; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.22); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; transition: background .18s ease, transform .18s ease; }
  .search-submit:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,0.34); transform: translateX(1px); }
  .search-submit svg{ width:19px; height:19px; }

  .panel{
    position:absolute; inset:14px; z-index:30; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    background:var(--cream); border-radius:24px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(50,5,10,0.45);
    overflow:hidden; opacity:0; transform: scale(.97) translateY(8px); pointer-events:none;
    transition: opacity .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1), transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1);
  }
  .panel.open{ opacity:1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); pointer-events:auto; }

  .browser-topbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 14px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffe2d6, #ffd6c4); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08); flex-shrink:0; }
  .browser-btn{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:12px; border:none; background:rgba(90,20,20,0.06); color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; flex-shrink:0; transition: background .15s ease, opacity .15s ease; }
  .browser-btn:hover{ background:rgba(90,20,20,0.12); }

  .browser-close{ background: rgba(90,20,20,0.08); margin-left: auto; }
  .browser-body{ position:relative; flex:1; background:#fff; }
  .browser-body iframe{ width:100%; height:100%; border:none; display:block; }

  .games-topbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:14px 16px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffe2d6, #ffd6c4); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08); flex-shrink:0; }
  .games-search{ flex:1; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#fff; border-radius:12px; padding:0 14px; border:1.5px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08); }
  .games-search:focus-within{ border-color: var(--red); }
  .games-search svg{ width:15px; height:15px; color:rgba(92,22,22,0.4); flex-shrink:0; }
  .games-search input{ flex:1; border:none; outline:none; background:transparent; padding:9px 4px; font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink); }

  .games-add-btn{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:0 16px; height:38px; border-radius:12px; border:none; background: var(--red); color:#fff; font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:13.5px; cursor:pointer; flex-shrink:0; transition: background .15s ease, transform .15s ease; }
  .games-add-btn:hover{ background: var(--red-deep); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .games-add-btn svg{ width:16px; height:16px; }

  .games-body{ position:relative; flex:1; overflow-y:auto; background:#fff; }
  .games-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap:16px; padding:20px; }

  .game-card{ position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; background: var(--cream); border:1px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08); cursor:pointer; text-align:left; transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; }
  .game-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(90,20,20,0.16); }

  .game-thumb{ width:100%; aspect-ratio: 4/3; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size:26px; color:#fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--red)); background-size:cover; background-position:center; }
  .game-info{ padding:10px 12px 12px; }
  .game-title{ font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; color: var(--ink); margin:0 0 2px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
  .game-tag{ font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; color: rgba(92,22,22,0.5); min-height: 14px; }

  .card-actions{ position:absolute; top:8px; right:8px; display:flex; gap:10px; opacity:0; transition: opacity .15s ease; }
  .game-card:hover .card-actions{ opacity:1; }

  .card-btn{ width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:99px; border:none; background: rgba(20,10,10,0.65); color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:pointer; transition: background .15s ease; }
  .card-btn:hover{ background: rgba(20,10,10,0.9); }
  .card-btn svg{ width:10px; height:10px; }

  .games-empty{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; padding:60px 30px; color: rgba(92,22,22,0.45); font-weight:600; font-size:14px; text-align:center; }
  .games-empty svg{ width:34px; height:34px; opacity:.5; }

  .games-menu-loading{
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    gap:14px; padding:80px 30px; color: var(--ink);
    font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:500;
  }

  .game-player{ position:absolute; inset:0; display:none; flex-direction:column; background:#fff; z-index:35; }
  .game-player.open{ display:flex; }

  .player-topbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 14px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffe2d6, #ffd6c4); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08); flex-shrink:0; }
  .player-title{ flex:1; font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:14.5px; color: var(--ink); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
  .player-body{ position:relative; flex:1; background:#fff; }
  .player-body iframe{ width:100%; height:100%; border:none; display:block; }

  .player-loading{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background: var(--cream);
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    gap:18px; z-index:40;
    opacity:1; transition: opacity .3s ease;
  }
  .player-loading.hidden{ opacity:0; pointer-events:none; }

  .spinner{
    width:44px; height:44px;
    border:4px solid rgba(92,22,22,0.12);
    border-top-color: var(--red);
    border-radius:50%;
    animation: spin 0.75s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

  .loading-text{
    font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size:20px; font-weight:600;
    color: var(--ink); letter-spacing:.3px;
  }

  .modal-overlay{ position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:50; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background: rgba(30,10,10,0.4); padding:20px; }
  .modal-overlay.open{ display:flex; }

  .modal-card{ width:min(440px, 100%); max-height:90vh; overflow-y:auto; background:#fff; border-radius:20px; padding:22px; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }
  .modal-card h2{ margin:0 0 16px; font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-size:22px; font-weight:600; color: var(--ink); }
  .modal-field{ margin-bottom:12px; }
  .modal-field label{ display:block; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color: rgba(92,22,22,0.6); margin-bottom:5px; }
  .modal-field input[type="text"], .modal-field input[type="password"]{ width:100%; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:10px; border:1.5px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.15); font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; color: var(--ink); outline:none; }
  .modal-field input[type="file"]{ width:100%; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:10px; border:1.5px dashed rgba(90,20,20,0.25); background: rgba(90,20,20,0.02); font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:13px; color: var(--ink); cursor:pointer; }
  .modal-field input:focus{ border-color: var(--red); }
  .modal-actions{ display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; margin-top:18px; }
  .modal-btn{ padding:10px 18px; border-radius:11px; border:none; font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:13.5px; cursor:pointer; }
  .modal-btn.cancel{ background: rgba(90,20,20,0.08); color: var(--ink); }
  .modal-btn.save{ background: var(--red); color:#fff; }

  /* ---------- THEMES ---------- */
  body[data-theme="ocean"]{
    --coral:#5aa9ff; --coral-deep:#2b6fd1; --red:#1f6fb2; --red-deep:#114a7c;
    --orange:#3ecfc0; --orange-deep:#16a394; --yellow:#8fe3ff; --yellow-soft:#bff2ff;
    --cream:#eef8ff; --ink:#123049; --sidebar:#2b6fd1; --sidebar-deep:#123a63;
  }
  body[data-theme="midnight"]{
    --coral:#4a3f6b; --coral-deep:#2c2440; --red:#1c1730; --red-deep:#100c1e;
    --orange:#7c5cff; --orange-deep:#5a3fd9; --yellow:#9d8bff; --yellow-soft:#c3b6ff;
    --cream:#f1ecff; --ink:#241b33; --sidebar:#2c2440; --sidebar-deep:#150f22;
  }

  /* ---------- PERFORMANCE MODE ---------- */
  body.perf-mode .blob{ animation:none !important; }
  body.perf-mode .search-box{ backdrop-filter:none !important; }
  body.perf-mode *{ transition:none !important; }
  body.perf-mode .grain{ display:none; }

  /* ---------- SETTINGS PANEL ---------- */
  .settings-topbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:14px 16px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffe2d6, #ffd6c4); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08); flex-shrink:0; }
  .settings-title{ flex:1; font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:18px; color: var(--ink); }
  .settings-body{ flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; background:#fff; }

  .setting-card{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px;
    background: var(--cream); border:1px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08);
    border-radius:16px; padding:16px 18px;
  }
  .setting-info h3{ font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; color: var(--ink); margin:0 0 3px; }
  .setting-info p{ font-size:12.5px; color: rgba(92,22,22,0.55); font-weight:600; }

  .setting-select{
    padding:9px 12px; border-radius:10px; border:1.5px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.15);
    font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:13.5px;
    color: var(--ink); background:#fff; outline:none; cursor:pointer; flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .setting-select:focus{ border-color: var(--red); }

  .setting-switch{ position:relative; display:inline-block; width:46px; height:26px; flex-shrink:0; }
  .setting-switch input{ opacity:0; width:0; height:0; }
  .setting-slider{
    position:absolute; cursor:pointer; inset:0; background: rgba(90,20,20,0.18);
    transition:.2s; border-radius:999px;
  }
  .setting-slider::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; height:20px; width:20px; left:3px; bottom:3px;
    background:#fff; transition:.2s; border-radius:50%;
  }
  .setting-switch input:checked + .setting-slider{ background: var(--red); }
  .setting-switch input:checked + .setting-slider::before{ transform: translateX(20px); }

  /* ---------- DEVELOPER MODE ---------- */
  body:not(.dev-mode) .dev-only{ display:none !important; }

  /* ---------- DEBUG PANEL (developer mode) ---------- */
  .dbg-tabs{ display:flex; gap:6px; }
  .dbg-tab{ border:none; background:rgba(90,20,20,0.06); color:var(--ink); font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; }
  .dbg-tab.active{ background:var(--red); color:#fff; }
  .dbg-body{ flex:1; min-height:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#fff; }
  .dbg-view{ display:none; flex:1; min-height:0; flex-direction:column; }
  .dbg-view.active{ display:flex; }
  .dbg-toolbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08); flex-shrink:0; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .dbg-note{ font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; color:rgba(92,22,22,0.6); }
  .dbg-log{ flex:1; min-height:0; overflow:auto; padding:10px 14px; font-family:ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size:12px; line-height:1.5; background:#1d1416; color:#f3e3dc; }
  .dbg-line{ white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; }
  .dbg-line .ts{ opacity:.45; margin-right:8px; }
  .dbg-line.error, .dbg-line.bad{ color:#ff8f8f; }
  .dbg-line.warn{ color:#ffd479; }
  .dbg-line.net{ color:#8fd3ff; }
  .dbg-line.debug{ opacity:.6; }
  .dbg-line.input{ color:#fff; }
  .dbg-line.result{ color:#9be59b; }
  .dbg-eval{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 14px; background:#2a1d20; color:#f3e3dc; font-family:ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; flex-shrink:0; margin:0; }
  .dbg-eval input{ flex:1; background:transparent; border:none; outline:none; color:#fff; font-family:ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size:13px; }
  .dbg-checks{ flex:1; min-height:0; overflow:auto; padding:12px 14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; }
  .dbg-check{ display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; background:var(--cream); border:1px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08); border-radius:12px; padding:10px 12px; }
  .dbg-dot{ width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:50%; margin-top:4px; flex-shrink:0; background:#bbb; }
  .dbg-dot.ok{ background:#2fb36b; }
  .dbg-dot.warn{ background:#f2a51f; }
  .dbg-dot.bad{ background:#e2434a; }
  .dbg-check-name{ font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); }
  .dbg-check-detail{ font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:rgba(92,22,22,0.6); word-break:break-word; margin-top:2px; }
  .dbg-table-wrap{ flex:1; min-height:0; overflow:auto; }
  .dbg-table{ border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:12px; }
  .dbg-table th, .dbg-table td{ text-align:left; padding:7px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(90,20,20,0.08); vertical-align:top; word-break:break-all; color:var(--ink); }
  .dbg-table th{ position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--cream); font-weight:700; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

  <nav class="sidebar">
    <div class="nav-list">
      <button class="nav-item active" id="navHome" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M3 11.5 12 4l9 7.5"/><path d="M5.5 10v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1H9.5a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h1a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1H17.5a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-9"/></svg>
        home
      </button>
      <button class="nav-item" id="navGames" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="2.5" y="7.5" width="19" height="10" rx="4"/><path d="M8 10.5v4M6 12.5h4"/><circle cx="15.55" cy="11.55" r="0.7"/><circle cx="17.45" cy="13.45" r="0.7"/></svg>
        games
      </button>
      <button class="nav-item" id="navBrowser" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3c2.5 2.6 3.8 5.7 3.8 9s-1.3 6.4-3.8 9c-2.5-2.6-3.8-5.7-3.8-9S9.5 5.6 12 3Z"/></svg>
        browser
      </button>
      <button class="nav-item" id="navSettings" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3.2"/><path d="M19.4 13.5a7.6 7.6 0 0 0 0-3l2-1.5-2-3.4-2.4.7a7.5 7.5 0 0 0-2.6-1.5L14 2h-4l-.4 2.4a7.5 7.5 0 0 0-2.6 1.5l-2.4-.7-2 3.4 2 1.5a7.6 7.6 0 0 0 0 3l-2 1.5 2 3.4 2.4-.7a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 2.6 1.5L10 22h4l.4-2.4a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 2.6-1.5l2.4.7 2-3.4-2-1.5Z"/></svg>
        settings
      </button>
      <button class="nav-item dev-only" id="navDebug" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M8 9a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v6a4 4 0 0 1-8 0Z"/><path d="M12 9v10M4 13h4M16 13h4M5 7l3 2M19 7l-3 2M5 20l3-2M19 20l-3-2"/></svg>
        debug
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="brand-tag">br4y</div>
  </nav>

  <main class="stage">
    <div class="blob-layer">
      <div class="blob b-floor"><svg viewBox="0 0 1000 500" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path fill="var(--red-deep)" d="M0,180 C220,90 340,260 560,190 C760,130 860,240 1000,170 L1000,500 L0,500 Z"/></svg></div>
      <div class="blob b-shadow"><svg viewBox="0 0 500 400" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path fill="#5c0f16" d="M500,0 L500,260 C380,300 300,200 220,150 C150,100 80,60 0,0 Z"/></svg></div>
      <div class="blob b-yellow"><svg viewBox="0 0 800 500" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path fill="var(--yellow)" d="M800,0 L800,180 C650,150 600,260 460,270 C330,280 260,190 120,220 C40,238 10,210 0,190 C120,60 260,10 420,40 C580,70 660,-10 800,0 Z"/></svg></div>
      <div class="blob b-orange"><svg viewBox="0 0 800 480" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path fill="var(--orange)" d="M0,150 C120,80 220,40 340,90 C460,140 470,240 380,300 C280,365 260,420 140,440 C60,452 20,410 0,380 Z"/></svg></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grain"></div>

    <div class="content">
      <div class="logo-wrap">
        <span class="logo">lava</span>
        <span class="logo-beta">beta</span>
      </div>

      <form class="search-form" id="homeSearchForm">
        <div class="search-box">
          <svg class="search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg>
          <input class="search-input" id="homeSearchInput" type="text" placeholder="type to get started…" autocomplete="off">
          <button class="search-submit" type="submit">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>

    <!-- BROWSER PANEL -->
    <div class="panel" id="browserPanel">
      <div class="browser-topbar">
        <button class="browser-btn browser-close" id="btnCloseBrowser" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button>
      </div>
      <div class="browser-body">
        <iframe id="browserFrame"></iframe>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- GAMES PANEL -->
    <div class="panel" id="gamesPanel">
      <div class="games-topbar">
        <div class="games-search">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg>
          <input id="gamesSearchInput" type="text" placeholder="search games…">
        </div>
        <button class="games-add-btn dev-only" id="btnAddGame" type="button">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>
          add game
        </button>
        <button class="browser-btn browser-close" id="btnCloseGames" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button>
      </div>

      <div class="games-body">
        <div class="games-menu-loading" id="gamesMenuLoading" style="display:none;">
          <div class="spinner"></div>
          <div>loading games library…</div>
        </div>
        <div class="games-grid" id="gamesGrid"></div>
        <div class="games-empty" id="gamesEmpty" style="display:none;">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><rect x="2.5" y="7.5" width="19" height="10" rx="4"/><path d="M8 10.5v4M6 12.5h4"/><circle cx="15.55" cy="11.55" r="0.7"/><circle cx="17.45" cy="13.45" r="0.7"/></svg>
          <span id="gamesEmptyText">no games yet — add one to get started</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="game-player" id="gamePlayer">
        <div class="player-topbar">
          <button class="browser-btn" id="btnPlayerBack" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg></button>
          <div class="player-title" id="playerTitle"></div>
          <button class="browser-btn" id="btnPlayerFullscreen" type="button" title="Toggle Fullscreen"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M8 3H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v3m18 0V5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-3m0 18h3a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-3M3 16v3a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h3"/></svg></button>
        </div>
        <div class="player-body">
          <div class="player-loading" id="playerLoading">
            <div class="spinner"></div>
            <div class="loading-text" id="loadingText">loading game…</div>
          </div>
          <iframe id="gameFrame" allow="fullscreen; gamepad; autoplay"></iframe>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- DEBUG PANEL (developer mode) -->
    <div class="panel" id="debugPanel">
      <div class="settings-topbar">
        <div class="settings-title">debug</div>
        <div class="dbg-tabs">
          <button type="button" class="dbg-tab active" data-tab="console">console</button>
          <button type="button" class="dbg-tab" data-tab="connect">connectivity</button>
          <button type="button" class="dbg-tab" data-tab="library">library</button>
        </div>
        <button class="browser-btn browser-close" id="btnCloseDebug" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button>
      </div>
      <div class="dbg-body">
        <div class="dbg-view active" id="dbgViewConsole">
          <div class="dbg-toolbar">
            <select class="setting-select" id="dbgFilter">
              <option value="all">everything</option>
              <option value="error">errors</option>
              <option value="warn">warnings + errors</option>
              <option value="net">network</option>
            </select>
            <button type="button" class="modal-btn cancel" id="btnDbgCopy">copy</button>
            <button type="button" class="modal-btn cancel" id="btnDbgClear">clear</button>
            <span class="dbg-note" id="dbgLogNote"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="dbg-log" id="dbgLog"></div>
          <form class="dbg-eval" id="dbgEvalForm">
            <span>></span>
            <input id="dbgEvalInput" type="text" placeholder="run javascript, e.g. lava.games.length" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
          </form>
        </div>
        <div class="dbg-view" id="dbgViewConnect">
          <div class="dbg-toolbar">
            <button type="button" class="modal-btn save" id="btnDbgRun">run checks</button>
            <span class="dbg-note" id="dbgRunNote"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="dbg-checks" id="dbgChecks"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="dbg-view" id="dbgViewLibrary">
          <div class="dbg-toolbar">
            <button type="button" class="modal-btn save" id="btnDbgRefresh">refresh library</button>
            <button type="button" class="modal-btn cancel" id="btnDbgClearThumbs">clear thumbnail cache</button>
            <button type="button" class="modal-btn cancel" id="btnDbgClearLocal">clear local edits</button>
            <button type="button" class="modal-btn cancel" id="btnDbgClearAll">clear cached data</button>
          </div>
          <div class="dbg-toolbar"><span class="dbg-note" id="dbgLibSummary"></span></div>
          <div class="dbg-table-wrap"><table class="dbg-table" id="dbgLibTable"></table></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SETTINGS PANEL -->
    <div class="panel" id="settingsPanel">
      <div class="settings-topbar">
        <div class="settings-title">settings</div>
        <button class="browser-btn browser-close" id="btnCloseSettings" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button>
      </div>
      <div class="settings-body">
        <div class="setting-card">
          <div class="setting-info">
            <h3>theme</h3>
            <p>switch the color palette</p>
          </div>
          <select class="setting-select" id="settingTheme">
            <option value="lava">lava (default)</option>
            <option value="ocean">ocean</option>
            <option value="midnight">midnight</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="setting-card">
          <div class="setting-info">
            <h3>performance mode</h3>
            <p>turns off the animated background and transitions for speed</p>
          </div>
          <label class="setting-switch">
            <input type="checkbox" id="settingPerf">
            <span class="setting-slider"></span>
          </label>
        </div>

        <div class="setting-card">
          <div class="setting-info">
            <h3>game launch behavior</h3>
            <p>choose how games open when you click one</p>
          </div>
          <select class="setting-select" id="settingLaunch">
            <option value="panel">open in the games panel</option>
            <option value="newtab">open in a new tab</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="setting-card">
          <div class="setting-info" style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
            <h3>developer mode</h3>
            <p>unlock adding games and editing names and thumbnails. needs the developer password.</p>
            <div class="dev-only" style="margin-top:10px;">
              <p id="devHashNote"></p>
              <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:6px;align-items:center;">
                <input class="setting-select" id="devHashOut" type="text" readonly style="flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:11px;">
                <button type="button" class="modal-btn cancel" id="btnDevChangePass">change password</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <label class="setting-switch">
            <input type="checkbox" id="settingDev">
            <span class="setting-slider"></span>
          </label>
        </div>

        <div class="setting-card dev-only">
          <div class="setting-info">
            <h3>github token (for saving edits)</h3>
            <p>lets name and thumbnail edits save to the repo so every visitor sees them. use a fine-grained token limited to the lava-games repo with contents: read and write. stored only in this browser.</p>
          </div>
          <input class="setting-select" id="settingToken" type="password" placeholder="github_pat_…" autocomplete="off" style="width:190px;">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- DEVELOPER PASSWORD MODAL -->
    <div class="modal-overlay" id="devPassModal">
      <form class="modal-card" id="devPassForm">
        <h2 id="devPassTitle">developer password</h2>
        <div class="modal-field">
          <label for="devPassInput">password</label>
          <input id="devPassInput" type="password" autocomplete="off">
        </div>
        <div class="modal-field" id="devPassConfirmField" style="display:none;">
          <label for="devPassConfirm">confirm password</label>
          <input id="devPassConfirm" type="password" autocomplete="off">
        </div>
        <div class="modal-field">
          <div id="devPassMsg" style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(92,22,22,0.6);"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button type="button" class="modal-btn cancel" id="btnDevPassCancel">cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" class="modal-btn save" id="btnDevPassSubmit">unlock</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>

    <!-- EDIT GAME MODAL (name + thumbnail) -->
    <div class="modal-overlay" id="thumbModal">
      <form class="modal-card" id="thumbForm">
        <h2 id="thumbModalTitle">edit game</h2>
        <input type="hidden" id="thumbGameId">
        <div class="modal-field">
          <label for="editNameInput">name</label>
          <input id="editNameInput" type="text" autocomplete="off">
        </div>
        <div class="modal-field">
          <label>thumbnail, step 1: find an image</label>
          <button type="button" class="modal-btn save" id="btnThumbGoogle" style="width:100%;">search google images</button>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-field">
          <label for="thumbUrlInput">step 2: right-click an image → copy image address, then paste it here</label>
          <input id="thumbUrlInput" type="text" placeholder="https://example.com/image.png" autocomplete="off">
        </div>
        <div class="modal-field">
          <div id="editStatus" style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(92,22,22,0.6);"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button type="button" class="modal-btn cancel" id="btnThumbReset">reset</button>
          <button type="button" class="modal-btn cancel" id="btnThumbCancel">cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" class="modal-btn save" id="btnThumbSave">save</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>

  </main>

<script>
(function(){
  // ---------- DEBUG LOG ----------
  // Always recording (last 400 lines) so nothing is missed; only shown in developer mode.
  const debugLog = [];
  const DEBUG_MAX = 400;
  let debugListener = null;

  function pushLog(level, args, bad){
    const text = args.map(a => {
      if(a instanceof Error) return a.stack || a.message;
      if(a && typeof a === 'object'){ try{ return JSON.stringify(a); }catch(e){ return String(a); } }
      return String(a);
    }).join(' ');
    const entry = { t: Date.now(), level, text: text.slice(0, 2000), bad: !!bad };
    debugLog.push(entry);
    if(debugLog.length > DEBUG_MAX) debugLog.shift();
    if(debugListener){ try{ debugListener(entry); }catch(e){} }
  }

  ['log', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'debug'].forEach(level => {
    const orig = console[level].bind(console);
    console[level] = (...args) => { pushLog(level, args); orig(...args); };
  });
  window.addEventListener('error', e => {
    pushLog('error', ['uncaught: ' + e.message + (e.filename ? ' (' + e.filename.split('/').pop() + ':' + e.lineno + ')' : '')]);
  });
  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', e => {
    pushLog('error', ['unhandled promise rejection: ' + ((e.reason && e.reason.message) || e.reason)]);
  });

  // log every request this page makes (address, result, time). Headers/tokens are never logged.
  const shortUrl = u => u.length > 130 ? u.slice(0, 127) + '…' : u;
  const realFetch = window.fetch.bind(window);
  window.fetch = async (input, init) => {
    const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : ((input && input.url) || String(input));
    const method = ((init && init.method) || (input && input.method) || 'GET').toUpperCase();
    const started = performance.now();
    try{
      const res = await realFetch(input, init);
      pushLog('net', [method + ' ' + shortUrl(url) + ' → ' + res.status + ' (' + Math.round(performance.now() - started) + 'ms)'], !res.ok);
      return res;
    }catch(err){
      pushLog('net', [method + ' ' + shortUrl(url) + ' FAILED: ' + err.message], true);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const navHome = document.getElementById('navHome');
  const navGames = document.getElementById('navGames');
  const navBrowser = document.getElementById('navBrowser');
  const navSettings = document.getElementById('navSettings');
  const navDebug = document.getElementById('navDebug');

  const settingsPanel = document.getElementById('settingsPanel');
  const debugPanel = document.getElementById('debugPanel');
  const btnCloseSettings = document.getElementById('btnCloseSettings');
  const settingTheme = document.getElementById('settingTheme');
  const settingPerf = document.getElementById('settingPerf');
  const settingLaunch = document.getElementById('settingLaunch');

  const browserPanel = document.getElementById('browserPanel');
  const browserFrame = document.getElementById('browserFrame');
  const btnCloseBrowser = document.getElementById('btnCloseBrowser');
  const homeSearchForm = document.getElementById('homeSearchForm');
  const homeSearchInput = document.getElementById('homeSearchInput');

  const gamesPanel = document.getElementById('gamesPanel');
  const gamesGrid = document.getElementById('gamesGrid');
  const gamesEmpty = document.getElementById('gamesEmpty');
  const gamesEmptyText = document.getElementById('gamesEmptyText');
  const gamesSearch = document.getElementById('gamesSearchInput');
  const gamesMenuLoading = document.getElementById('gamesMenuLoading');


  const gamePlayer = document.getElementById('gamePlayer');
  const gameFrame = document.getElementById('gameFrame');
  const playerTitle = document.getElementById('playerTitle');
  const playerLoading = document.getElementById('playerLoading');
  const loadingText = document.getElementById('loadingText');
  const btnPlayerFullscreen = document.getElementById('btnPlayerFullscreen');

  const thumbModal = document.getElementById('thumbModal');
  const thumbUrlInput = document.getElementById('thumbUrlInput');

  let activeGames = [];

  function setActiveNav(which){
    [navHome, navGames, navBrowser, navSettings, navDebug].forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    if(which === 'home') navHome.classList.add('active');
    if(which === 'games') navGames.classList.add('active');
    if(which === 'browser') navBrowser.classList.add('active');
    if(which === 'settings') navSettings.classList.add('active');
    if(which === 'debug') navDebug.classList.add('active');
  }

  function closeAllPanels(){
    browserPanel.classList.remove('open');
    gamesPanel.classList.remove('open');
    settingsPanel.classList.remove('open');
    debugPanel.classList.remove('open');
  }

  navHome.addEventListener('click', () => { closeAllPanels(); setActiveNav('home'); });
  
  navGames.addEventListener('click', () => { 
    closeAllPanels(); 
    gamesPanel.classList.add('open'); 
    setActiveNav('games'); 
    loadGames(); 
  });
  
  document.getElementById('btnCloseGames').addEventListener('click', () => { 
    gamesPanel.classList.remove('open'); 
    setActiveNav('home'); 
  });

  // ---------- SETTINGS ----------
  const SETTINGS_KEY = 'lava_settings_v1';
  const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = { theme: 'lava', perf: false, launch: 'panel' };

  function loadSettingsFromStorage(){
    try{
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY);
      if(!raw) return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS };
      return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...JSON.parse(raw) };
    }catch(e){
      return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS };
    }
  }

  function saveSettingsToStorage(s){
    try{ localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(s)); }
    catch(e){ /* storage unavailable */ }
  }

  let settings = loadSettingsFromStorage();

  function applySettings(){
    if(settings.theme === 'lava'){
      document.body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    } else {
      document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', settings.theme);
    }
    document.body.classList.toggle('perf-mode', !!settings.perf);
  }

  function applyControlsToUI(){
    settingTheme.value = settings.theme;
    settingPerf.checked = !!settings.perf;
    settingLaunch.value = settings.launch;
  }

  applySettings();
  applyControlsToUI();

  navSettings.addEventListener('click', () => {
    closeAllPanels();
    settingsPanel.classList.add('open');
    setActiveNav('settings');
  });

  btnCloseSettings.addEventListener('click', () => {
    settingsPanel.classList.remove('open');
    setActiveNav('home');
  });

  settingTheme.addEventListener('change', () => {
    settings.theme = settingTheme.value;
    applySettings();
    saveSettingsToStorage(settings);
  });

  settingPerf.addEventListener('change', () => {
    settings.perf = settingPerf.checked;
    applySettings();
    saveSettingsToStorage(settings);
  });

  settingLaunch.addEventListener('change', () => {
    settings.launch = settingLaunch.value;
    saveSettingsToStorage(settings);
  });

  navBrowser.addEventListener('click', () => {
    closeAllPanels();
    browserPanel.classList.add('open');
    setActiveNav('browser');
    if(!browserFrame.src || browserFrame.src === 'about:blank') {
      browserFrame.src = 'https://www.google.com/search?igu=1';
    }
  });

  btnCloseBrowser.addEventListener('click', () => {
    browserPanel.classList.remove('open');
    setActiveNav('home');
  });

  homeSearchForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const query = homeSearchInput.value.trim();
    if(query) {
      closeAllPanels();
      browserPanel.classList.add('open');
      setActiveNav('browser');
      const targetUrl = (query.startsWith('http://') || query.startsWith('https://')) 
        ? query 
        : `https://www.google.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&igu=1`;
      browserFrame.src = targetUrl;
    }
  });

  // ---------- GITHUB GAME LIBRARY ----------
  // Games are read straight from the GitHub repo: every top-level folder that
  // contains an index.html shows up as a game. No games.json / server.js needed.
  const GH_OWNER  = 'braydensrandomcreations';
  const GH_REPO   = 'lava-games';
  const GH_BRANCH = 'main';

  // Games are found by scanning the repo's folders for index.html and are played straight
  // from those repo files, served through the jsDelivr CDN (no GitHub Pages needed).
  // GitHub's own raw file links can't be used to run games: they label every file "plain text".
  const API_BASE = `https://api.github.com/repos/${GH_OWNER}/${GH_REPO}`;
  const cdnBase  = ref => `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/${GH_OWNER}/${GH_REPO}@${ref}/`;
  const OVERRIDES_FILE = 'lava-overrides.json';   // shared name/thumbnail edits, see below
  const UPLOAD_URL = `https://github.com/${GH_OWNER}/${GH_REPO}/upload/${GH_BRANCH}`;

  const CACHE_KEY = 'lava_games_cache_v4';
  const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000; // GitHub's API allows 60 requests/hour per visitor, so cache

  // optional per-folder tweaks: { title, tag, thumb, search }
  //   thumb  = any image URL (always wins)
  //   search = what to look up on Wikipedia if the title alone won't find it
  // folders without an entry get a title made from the folder name
  const GAME_OVERRIDES = {
    'btd1':     { title: 'Bloons TD 1', search: 'Bloons Tower Defense' },
    'btd2':     { title: 'Bloons TD 2', search: 'Bloons Tower Defense' },
    'btd3':     { title: 'Bloons TD 3', search: 'Bloons Tower Defense' },
    'btd4':     { title: 'Bloons TD 4', search: 'Bloons Tower Defense' },
    'btd5':     { title: 'Bloons TD 5', search: 'Bloons Tower Defense' },
    'bloons':   { title: 'Bloons',      search: 'Bloons Tower Defense' },
    'moto-x3m': { title: 'Moto X3M' },
    '2048':     { title: '2048' }
  };

  // Thumbnails found inside the repo itself (checked before any online lookup):
  // any image in the game's folder named like thumbnail / cover / preview / splash / title / logo / icon
  const IMG_RE = /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|svg|ico)$/i;

  function scoreImage(rest, size){
    const file = rest[rest.length - 1];
    if(!IMG_RE.test(file)) return -1;
    if(size && (size < 300 || size > 1500000)) return -1;
    const base = file.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '').toLowerCase();
    let s;
    if(/^(thumb(nail)?s?|cover|preview|poster|banner|screenshot|og[-_]?image|social|share)/.test(base)) s = 100;
    else if(/^favicon/.test(base)) s = 20;
    else if(/^(splash|title|titlescreen|menu|logo|loading|icon|app[-_]?icon|apple[-_]touch[-_]icon)/.test(base)) s = 60;
    else return -1;
    s -= (rest.length - 1) * 8;               // prefer files near the top of the folder
    if(/\.svg$/i.test(file)) s -= 10;
    if(/\.ico$/i.test(file)) s -= 30;
    return s;
  }

  function prettifyName(dir){
    return dir.replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
  }

  function encodePath(p){
    return p.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
  }

  function buildGames(tree, ref, remote){
    remote = remote || {};
    const cdn = cdnBase(ref);
    const found = new Map();

    tree.forEach(item => {
      if(item.type !== 'blob') return;
      const parts = item.path.split('/');
      if(parts.length < 2 || parts[0].startsWith('.')) return;

      const dir = parts[0];
      const rest = parts.slice(1);
      let g = found.get(dir);
      if(!g){ g = { dir, index: null, thumb: null, thumbScore: -1 }; found.set(dir, g); }

      if(rest[rest.length - 1].toLowerCase() === 'index.html'){
        const p = rest.join('/');
        if(!g.index || rest.length < g.index.split('/').length) g.index = p;
      }
      const sc = scoreImage(rest, item.size);
      if(sc > g.thumbScore){ g.thumbScore = sc; g.thumb = item.path; }
    });

    return Array.from(found.values())
      .filter(g => g.index)
      .map(g => {
        const o = GAME_OVERRIDES[g.dir] || {};
        const r = remote[g.dir] || {};
        const baseTitle = o.title || prettifyName(g.dir);
        const baseThumb = o.thumb || (g.thumb ? cdn + encodePath(g.thumb) : '');
        return {
          id: g.dir,
          baseTitle,
          baseThumb,
          title: r.title || baseTitle,
          search: o.search || '',
          tag: r.tag || o.tag || '',
          thumbUrl: r.thumb || baseThumb,
          playUrl: cdn + encodePath(g.dir) + '/' + encodePath(g.index)
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title, undefined, { numeric: true }));
  }

  function readCache(allowStale){
    try{
      const c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY) || 'null');
      if(c && Array.isArray(c.games) && (allowStale || Date.now() - c.time < CACHE_TTL)) return c.games;
    }catch(e){}
    return null;
  }

  // names + thumbnails edited in the full version live in this one file in the repo,
  // and every visitor reads it, so everyone sees the same thing
  async function fetchOverrides(tree, ref){
    if(!tree.some(t => t.type === 'blob' && t.path === OVERRIDES_FILE)) return {};
    const res = await fetch(cdnBase(ref) + OVERRIDES_FILE);
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error('overrides ' + res.status);
    const data = await res.json();
    return (data && typeof data === 'object') ? data : {};
  }

  async function fetchLibrary(){
    const fresh = readCache(false);
    if(fresh){ console.debug('[library] using saved list (' + fresh.length + ' games)'); return fresh; }

    try{
      const headers = { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json' };

      // pin everything to the newest commit so new games show up right away
      // (the CDN can hold on to a plain "main" for hours)
      let ref = GH_BRANCH, treeRef = GH_BRANCH;
      try{
        const cr = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/commits/${GH_BRANCH}`, { headers });
        if(cr.ok){
          const c = await cr.json();
          if(c.sha && c.commit && c.commit.tree && c.commit.tree.sha){ ref = c.sha; treeRef = c.commit.tree.sha; }
        }
      }catch(e){ /* fall back to the branch name */ }

      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/git/trees/${treeRef}?recursive=1`, { headers });
      if(!res.ok) throw new Error('GitHub responded ' + res.status);
      const data = await res.json();
      const remote = await fetchOverrides(data.tree || [], ref);
      const games = buildGames(data.tree || [], ref, remote);
      console.info('[library] loaded ' + games.length + ' games from GitHub @' + String(ref).slice(0, 7) + (data.truncated ? ' (file list was truncated!)' : ''));
      try{ localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ time: Date.now(), games })); }catch(e){}
      return games;
    }catch(err){
      const stale = readCache(true);   // rate-limited or offline: fall back to the last good copy
      console.warn('[library] GitHub failed (' + err.message + '), ' + (stale ? 'using the last saved list' : 'nothing saved to fall back on'));
      if(stale) return stale;
      throw err;
    }
  }

  async function loadGames(){
    gamesGrid.style.display = 'none';
    gamesEmpty.style.display = 'none';
    gamesMenuLoading.style.display = 'flex';

    try {
      rawGames = await fetchLibrary();
      refreshGames();
    } catch(err) {
      console.error('Failed to load games:', err);
      gamesEmpty.style.display = 'flex';
      gamesEmptyText.textContent = 'could not load games from GitHub — try again in a minute';
    } finally {
      gamesMenuLoading.style.display = 'none';
      gamesGrid.style.display = 'grid';
    }
  }

  // ---------- DEVELOPER MODE ----------
  // Adding games and editing names/thumbnails stay hidden until developer mode is switched on
  // in settings, which needs a password. This is a convenience lock, not real security (anyone
  // can read this file). What actually protects the repo is the GitHub token.
  const DEV_PASSWORD_HASH = '5a43ef8d1bbfa026ecff2fefc169e7d848813066534049ef406b0b7576b0d269';   // developer password lock (applies to everyone)
  const DEV_HASH_KEY = 'lava_dev_hash_v1';
  const DEV_SESSION_KEY = 'lava_dev_on';

  const settingDev = document.getElementById('settingDev');
  const devPassModal = document.getElementById('devPassModal');
  const devPassInput = document.getElementById('devPassInput');
  const devPassConfirm = document.getElementById('devPassConfirm');
  const devPassConfirmField = document.getElementById('devPassConfirmField');
  const devPassTitle = document.getElementById('devPassTitle');
  const devPassMsg = document.getElementById('devPassMsg');
  const devPassSubmit = document.getElementById('btnDevPassSubmit');
  const devHashOut = document.getElementById('devHashOut');
  const devHashNote = document.getElementById('devHashNote');
  const btnDevChangePass = document.getElementById('btnDevChangePass');
  let devPassMode = 'unlock';

  async function hashPassword(pw){
    if(typeof crypto === 'undefined' || !crypto.subtle) throw new Error('needs https or localhost');
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode('lava-dev:' + pw));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  }
  function storedHash(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem(DEV_HASH_KEY) || ''; }catch(e){ return ''; }
  }
  function effectiveHash(){
    return DEV_PASSWORD_HASH || storedHash();
  }

  function updateDevExtra(){
    devHashOut.value = effectiveHash();
    devHashNote.textContent = DEV_PASSWORD_HASH
      ? 'password is set in the file, so it applies to everyone.'
      : 'password is only saved in this browser. to lock it for everyone, paste this hash into DEV_PASSWORD_HASH in the file.';
    btnDevChangePass.style.display = DEV_PASSWORD_HASH ? 'none' : '';
  }

  function setDevMode(on){
    document.body.classList.toggle('dev-mode', on);
    settingDev.checked = on;
    try{ if(on) sessionStorage.setItem(DEV_SESSION_KEY, '1'); else sessionStorage.removeItem(DEV_SESSION_KEY); }catch(e){}
    if(on) updateDevExtra();
    onDevModeChange(on);
  }

  function openDevPass(mode){
    devPassMode = mode;
    devPassInput.value = '';
    devPassConfirm.value = '';
    devPassMsg.textContent = mode === 'set' ? 'no developer password yet. choose one; it is saved in this browser.' : '';
    devPassConfirmField.style.display = mode === 'unlock' ? 'none' : '';
    devPassTitle.textContent = mode === 'unlock' ? 'developer password' : (mode === 'set' ? 'set a developer password' : 'change developer password');
    devPassSubmit.textContent = mode === 'unlock' ? 'unlock' : 'save';
    devPassModal.classList.add('open');
    setTimeout(() => devPassInput.focus(), 50);
  }

  settingDev.addEventListener('change', () => {
    if(!settingDev.checked){ setDevMode(false); return; }
    settingDev.checked = false;                 // stays off until the password is accepted
    openDevPass(effectiveHash() ? 'unlock' : 'set');
  });

  btnDevChangePass.addEventListener('click', () => openDevPass('change'));
  document.getElementById('btnDevPassCancel').addEventListener('click', () => devPassModal.classList.remove('open'));

  document.getElementById('devPassForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pw = devPassInput.value;
    if(!pw){ devPassMsg.textContent = 'enter a password'; return; }

    try{
      if(devPassMode === 'unlock'){
        if(await hashPassword(pw) === effectiveHash()){
          devPassModal.classList.remove('open');
          setDevMode(true);
        } else {
          devPassMsg.textContent = 'wrong password';
          devPassInput.value = '';
        }
        return;
      }

      if(pw.length < 4){ devPassMsg.textContent = 'use at least 4 characters'; return; }
      if(pw !== devPassConfirm.value){ devPassMsg.textContent = 'passwords do not match'; return; }
      localStorage.setItem(DEV_HASH_KEY, await hashPassword(pw));
      devPassModal.classList.remove('open');
      setDevMode(true);
      updateDevExtra();
    }catch(err){
      devPassMsg.textContent = err.message || 'something went wrong';
    }
  });

  // ---------- EDITING: name + thumbnail ----------
  // Edits are saved to lava-overrides.json in the repo (needs the GitHub token from settings).
  // Everyone who opens the site reads that file, so they all see the same names and
  // thumbnails. Without a token, edits are kept in this browser only.
  const TOKEN_KEY = 'lava_gh_token_v1';
  const LOCAL_EDITS_KEY = 'lava_local_edits_v1';

  const settingToken = document.getElementById('settingToken');
  const thumbNameInput = document.getElementById('editNameInput');
  const thumbStatus = document.getElementById('editStatus');

  function getToken(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY) || ''; }catch(e){ return ''; }
  }
  settingToken.value = getToken();
  settingToken.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const t = settingToken.value.trim();
    try{ if(t) localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, t); else localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY); }catch(e){}
  });

  function loadLocalEdits(){
    try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_EDITS_KEY) || '{}') || {}; }
    catch(e){ return {}; }
  }
  function saveLocalEdits(){
    try{ localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_EDITS_KEY, JSON.stringify(localEdits)); }catch(e){}
  }
  let localEdits = loadLocalEdits();

  // bring over thumbnails saved by the earlier version (they were browser-only)
  try{
    const old = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lava_thumbs_v1') || 'null');
    if(old){
      Object.keys(old).forEach(id => { if(!localEdits[id]) localEdits[id] = { thumb: old[id] }; });
      saveLocalEdits();
      localStorage.removeItem('lava_thumbs_v1');
    }
  }catch(e){}

  let rawGames = [];   // the library as read from the repo (with the shared edits applied)

  function sortGames(list){
    return list.slice().sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title, undefined, { numeric: true }));
  }
  function prepareGames(list){        // + edits that only exist in this browser
    return sortGames(list.map(g => {
      const e = localEdits[g.id];
      return e ? { ...g, title: e.title || g.title, thumbUrl: e.thumb || g.thumbUrl } : g;
    }));
  }
  function refreshGames(){
    activeGames = prepareGames(rawGames);
    renderGames(gamesSearch.value);
  }

  const utf8ToB64 = s => btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)));
  const b64ToUtf8 = s => decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(s.replace(/\s/g, ''))));

 // read the current file, change one game's entry, write it back (retries if someone else saved first)
  async function saveOverridesRemote(id, patch){
    const rawToken = getToken().trim();
    if(!rawToken) throw new Error('No GitHub token provided');

    // Standardize token header format for classic (ghp_) vs fine-grained (github_pat_) tokens
    const authHeader = rawToken.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')
      ? rawToken 
      : `Bearer ${rawToken}`;

    const url = `${API_BASE}/contents/${OVERRIDES_FILE}`;
    const headers = { 
      'Authorization': authHeader, 
      'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
      'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28'
    };

    for(let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++){
      let sha, data = {};
      const gr = await fetch(`${url}?ref=${GH_BRANCH}&t=${Date.now()}`, { headers });
      
      if(gr.ok){
        const j = await gr.json();
        sha = j.sha;
        try{ data = JSON.parse(b64ToUtf8(j.content)) || {}; }catch(e){ data = {}; }
      } else if(gr.status === 401 || gr.status === 403){
        const errJson = await gr.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errJson.message || `Token rejected (${gr.status})`);
      } else if(gr.status !== 404){
        throw new Error('GitHub ' + gr.status);
      }

      if(patch) data[id] = patch; else delete data[id];

      const body = {
        message: 'lava: update ' + id,
        content: utf8ToB64(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) + '\n'),
        branch: GH_BRANCH
      };
      if(sha) body.sha = sha;

      const pr = await fetch(url, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { ...headers, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(body)
      });

      if(pr.ok) return;
      if(pr.status === 401 || pr.status === 403){
        const errJson = await pr.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errJson.message || `Token permission denied (${pr.status})`);
      }
      if(pr.status === 409 || pr.status === 422) continue;
      throw new Error('GitHub ' + pr.status);
    }
    throw new Error('File changed while saving, try again');
  }

  // keep the local copy of the library in step with what was just saved
  function patchLibrary(id, patch){
    rawGames = rawGames.map(g => g.id !== id ? g : {
      ...g,
      title: (patch && patch.title) || g.baseTitle,
      thumbUrl: (patch && patch.thumb) || g.baseThumb
    });
    try{ localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ time: Date.now(), games: rawGames })); }catch(e){}
  }

  let saving = false;

  async function saveEdit(id, patch){        // patch = { title?, thumb? }, or null to reset
    if(saving) return;
    const setLocal = () => {
      if(patch) localEdits[id] = { ...patch }; else delete localEdits[id];
      saveLocalEdits();
      refreshGames();
    };

    if(!getToken()){
      setLocal();
      thumbModal.classList.remove('open');
      return;
    }

    saving = true;
    thumbStatus.textContent = 'saving to GitHub…';
    try{
      await saveOverridesRemote(id, patch);
      delete localEdits[id];
      saveLocalEdits();
      patchLibrary(id, patch);
      refreshGames();
      thumbModal.classList.remove('open');
    }catch(err){
      console.error('Save failed:', err);
      setLocal();
      thumbStatus.textContent = `couldn't save to GitHub (${err.message}). kept in this browser only. check the token in settings.`;
    }finally{
      saving = false;
    }
  }

  function openThumbModal(game){
    document.getElementById('thumbGameId').value = game.id;
    document.getElementById('thumbModalTitle').textContent = 'edit ' + game.title;
    thumbNameInput.value = game.title;
    thumbUrlInput.value = game.thumbUrl !== game.baseThumb ? game.thumbUrl : '';
    thumbStatus.textContent = getToken()
      ? 'saves to the GitHub repo, so everyone sees it.'
      : 'no GitHub token in settings, so this only saves in this browser.';
    thumbModal.classList.add('open');
  }

  document.getElementById('btnThumbGoogle').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const q = encodeURIComponent((thumbNameInput.value.trim() || 'video') + ' game');
    window.open(`https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=${q}`, '_blank', 'noopener');
  });

  document.getElementById('btnThumbCancel').addEventListener('click', () => thumbModal.classList.remove('open'));

  document.getElementById('btnThumbReset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    saveEdit(document.getElementById('thumbGameId').value, null);
  });

  document.getElementById('thumbForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = document.getElementById('thumbGameId').value;
    const game = rawGames.find(g => g.id === id);
    const title = thumbNameInput.value.trim();
    const thumb = thumbUrlInput.value.trim();

    if(thumb && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(thumb) && !/^data:image\//i.test(thumb)){
      alert('Paste a full image address starting with https://');
      return;
    }

    const patch = {};
    if(title && (!game || title !== game.baseTitle)) patch.title = title;
    if(thumb && (!game || thumb !== game.baseThumb)) patch.thumb = thumb;
    saveEdit(id, (patch.title || patch.thumb) ? patch : null);
  });

  // ---------- AUTOMATIC THUMBNAILS ----------
  // For games with no thumbnail in the repo, one is found automatically, in this order:
  //   1. the game's own page (its share image / app icon), fetched from the repo
  //   2. Wikipedia's image for the game (works straight from the browser)
  //   3. the game's small favicon, shown as an icon on the card
  // Google itself can't be searched from a web page without a paid API key.
  // Results are cached in this browser.
  const AUTO_THUMBS = true;
  const AUTO_KEY = 'lava_autothumbs_v2';
  const AUTO_MISS_TTL = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // retry games with no match after a day

  function loadAutoThumbs(){
    try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(AUTO_KEY) || '{}') || {}; }
    catch(e){ return {}; }
  }
  let autoThumbs = loadAutoThumbs();
  function saveAutoThumbs(){
    try{ localStorage.setItem(AUTO_KEY, JSON.stringify(autoThumbs)); }catch(e){}
  }

  function looksAutoNamed(title){
    return /^game[\s-]?\d+$/i.test(title.trim()) || /^\d{6,}$/.test(title.trim());
  }

  function titleTokens(s){
    return s.toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean);
  }

  function getAttr(tag, name){
    const m = tag.match(new RegExp('\\b' + name + '\\s*=\\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|\'([^\']*)\'|([^\\s>]+))', 'i'));
    return m ? (m[1] || m[2] || m[3] || '') : '';
  }

  async function findPageImage(game){
    const res = await fetch(game.playUrl);
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error('page ' + res.status);
    const html = (await res.text()).slice(0, 200000);
    const abs = href => {
      try{ const u = new URL(href, game.playUrl); return /^https?:$/.test(u.protocol) ? u.href : ''; }
      catch(e){ return ''; }
    };
    let best = '', icon = '';

    (html.match(/<meta\b[^>]*>/gi) || []).forEach(tag => {
      const key = (getAttr(tag, 'property') || getAttr(tag, 'name')).toLowerCase();
      if(!best && (key === 'og:image' || key === 'twitter:image' || key === 'twitter:image:src')){
        best = abs(getAttr(tag, 'content'));
      }
    });
    (html.match(/<link\b[^>]*>/gi) || []).forEach(tag => {
      const rel = getAttr(tag, 'rel').toLowerCase();
      const href = getAttr(tag, 'href');
      if(!href) return;
      if(!best && rel.includes('apple-touch-icon')) best = abs(href);
      else if(!icon && /\bicon\b/.test(rel)) icon = abs(href);
    });
    return { best, icon };
  }

  async function findWikipedia(game){
    const name = game.search || game.title;
    const q = encodeURIComponent(name + ' video game');
    const url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&generator=search&gsrlimit=5' +
      `&gsrsearch=${q}&prop=pageimages&piprop=thumbnail&pithumbsize=400&pilimit=5` +
      '&format=json&formatversion=2&origin=*';
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error('lookup failed');
    const data = await res.json();
    const pages = ((data.query && data.query.pages) || []).slice().sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
    const want = titleTokens(name);

    // only accept an article whose title contains every word we searched for,
    // so a game with no article doesn't get a random unrelated picture
    for(const p of pages){
      if(!p.thumbnail || !p.thumbnail.source) continue;
      const have = titleTokens(p.title);
      if(want.length && want.every(w => have.includes(w))) return p.thumbnail.source;
    }
    return '';
  }

  async function resolveAuto(game){
    let page = { best: '', icon: '' }, pageFailed = false;
    try{ page = await findPageImage(game); }catch(e){ pageFailed = true; }
    if(page.best) return { url: page.best };

    let wiki = '', wikiFailed = false;
    if(!looksAutoNamed(game.title)){
      try{ wiki = await findWikipedia(game); }catch(e){ wikiFailed = true; }
    }
    if(wiki) return { url: wiki };
    if(page.icon) return { url: page.icon, fit: 'icon' };

    if(pageFailed || wikiFailed) throw new Error('lookup failed'); // don't remember a miss caused by an error
    return { url: '' };
  }

  const autoQueue = [];
  let autoWorkers = 0;

  function pumpAutoQueue(){
    while(autoWorkers < 3 && autoQueue.length){
      const job = autoQueue.shift();
      autoWorkers++;
      resolveAuto(job.game)
        .then(entry => {
          autoThumbs[job.game.id] = { url: entry.url, fit: entry.fit || '', time: Date.now() };
          saveAutoThumbs();
          console.debug('[thumb] ' + job.game.id + ' → ' + (entry.url ? entry.url.slice(0, 90) : 'no match'));
          if(entry.url) showAutoThumb(job.el, entry);
        })
        .catch(err => { console.warn('[thumb] ' + job.game.id + ' lookup failed: ' + (err && err.message)); })
        .finally(() => { autoWorkers--; pumpAutoQueue(); });
    }
  }

  function showAutoThumb(el, entry){
    if(entry.fit === 'icon'){
      el.style.backgroundImage = `url("${entry.url}"), linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--red))`;
      el.style.backgroundSize = '42% auto, cover';
      el.style.backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat, no-repeat';
    } else {
      el.style.backgroundImage = `url("${entry.url}")`;
    }
    el.textContent = '';
  }

  function autoThumb(game, el){
    if(!AUTO_THUMBS) return;
    const hit = autoThumbs[game.id];
    if(hit){
      if(hit.url){ showAutoThumb(el, hit); return; }
      if(Date.now() - hit.time < AUTO_MISS_TTL) return;
    }
    if(!autoQueue.some(j => j.game.id === game.id && j.el === el)) autoQueue.push({ game, el });
    pumpAutoQueue();
  }

  function renderGames(filterText = ''){
    const q = filterText.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = activeGames.filter(g =>
      !q || g.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (g.tag || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );

    gamesGrid.innerHTML = '';

    if(activeGames.length === 0){
      gamesEmpty.style.display = 'flex';
      gamesEmptyText.textContent = 'no games found in the GitHub repo yet — click "add game" to upload one';
      return;
    }
    if(filtered.length === 0){
      gamesEmpty.style.display = 'flex';
      gamesEmptyText.textContent = 'no games match "' + filterText + '"';
      return;
    }
    gamesEmpty.style.display = 'none';

    filtered.forEach(g => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'game-card';

      const thumb = document.createElement('div');
      thumb.className = 'game-thumb';
      const thumbSrc = g.thumbUrl;
      if(thumbSrc) {
        thumb.style.backgroundImage = `url("${thumbSrc}")`;
      } else {
        thumb.textContent = g.title.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
        autoThumb(g, thumb);
      }

      const info = document.createElement('div');
      info.className = 'game-info';

      const title = document.createElement('div');
      title.className = 'game-title';
      title.textContent = g.title;

      const tag = document.createElement('div');
      tag.className = 'game-tag';
      tag.textContent = g.tag || '';

      info.appendChild(title);
      info.appendChild(tag);

      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'card-actions dev-only';

      const btnThumb = document.createElement('button');
      btnThumb.className = 'card-btn';
      btnThumb.title = 'Edit name / thumbnail';
      btnThumb.type = 'button';
      btnThumb.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/></svg>';
      btnThumb.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        openThumbModal(g);
      });
      actions.appendChild(btnThumb);

      card.appendChild(thumb);
      card.appendChild(info);
      card.appendChild(actions);

      card.addEventListener('click', () => playGame(g));
      gamesGrid.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  gamesSearch.addEventListener('input', () => renderGames(gamesSearch.value));

  // The game's index.html is downloaded from the repo and shown in the player, with a <base>
  // pointing at its folder so its scripts, images and sounds load from the repo too.
  async function fetchGameHtml(game){
    const res = await fetch(game.playUrl);
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    let html = await res.text();

    const dir = game.playUrl.slice(0, game.playUrl.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
    const base = `<base href="${dir}">`;
    html = html.replace(/<base\b[^>]*>/gi, '');
    if(/<head\b[^>]*>/i.test(html))      html = html.replace(/<head\b[^>]*>/i, m => m + base);
    else if(/<html\b[^>]*>/i.test(html)) html = html.replace(/<html\b[^>]*>/i, m => m + '<head>' + base + '</head>');
    else if(/<!doctype[^>]*>/i.test(html)) html = html.replace(/<!doctype[^>]*>/i, m => m + base);
    else html = base + html;
    return html;
  }

  let playToken = 0;

  async function playGame(game){
    const token = ++playToken;

    if(settings.launch === 'newtab'){
      const w = window.open('about:blank', '_blank');
      try{
        const html = await fetchGameHtml(game);
        if(!w) throw new Error('popup blocked');
        w.location.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }));
      }catch(err){
        if(w) w.close();
        alert('Could not open ' + game.title + ' in a new tab (allow pop-ups, or try the games panel).');
      }
      return;
    }

    playerTitle.textContent = game.title;
    loadingText.textContent = `loading ${game.title}…`;
    playerLoading.classList.remove('hidden');
    gamePlayer.classList.add('open');

    try{
      const html = await fetchGameHtml(game);
      if(token !== playToken) return;          // you went back or picked another game
      gameFrame.srcdoc = html;
    }catch(err){
      if(token !== playToken) return;
      console.error('Failed to load game:', err);
      loadingText.textContent = `could not load ${game.title} — try again in a moment`;
    }
  }

  btnPlayerFullscreen.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
      if (gamePlayer.requestFullscreen) {
        gamePlayer.requestFullscreen();
      } else if (gamePlayer.webkitRequestFullscreen) {
        gamePlayer.webkitRequestFullscreen();
      } else if (gamePlayer.msRequestFullscreen) {
        gamePlayer.msRequestFullscreen();
      }
    } else {
      if (document.exitFullscreen) {
        document.exitFullscreen();
      } else if (document.webkitExitFullscreen) {
        document.webkitExitFullscreen();
      } else if (document.msExitFullscreen) {
        document.msExitFullscreen();
      }
    }
  });

  gameFrame.addEventListener('load', () => {
    if (gameFrame.hasAttribute('srcdoc') || (gameFrame.src && gameFrame.src !== 'about:blank')) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        playerLoading.classList.add('hidden');
      }, 300);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('btnPlayerBack').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (document.fullscreenElement) {
      document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {});
    }
    gamePlayer.classList.remove('open');
    playToken++;
    gameFrame.removeAttribute('srcdoc');
    gameFrame.src = 'about:blank';
    playerLoading.classList.remove('hidden');
  });

  // "add game" now sends you to GitHub's upload page for the repo
  document.getElementById('btnAddGame').addEventListener('click', () => {
    window.open(UPLOAD_URL, '_blank', 'noopener');
  });
  // ---------- DEBUG TOOLS (developer mode) ----------
  const dbgLog = document.getElementById('dbgLog');
  const dbgFilter = document.getElementById('dbgFilter');
  const dbgLogNote = document.getElementById('dbgLogNote');
  const dbgEvalInput = document.getElementById('dbgEvalInput');
  const dbgChecks = document.getElementById('dbgChecks');
  const dbgRunNote = document.getElementById('dbgRunNote');
  const dbgLibSummary = document.getElementById('dbgLibSummary');
  const dbgLibTable = document.getElementById('dbgLibTable');
  let dbgTab = 'console';

  const timeStr = t => new Date(t).toTimeString().slice(0, 8);

  function passesFilter(e){
    if(e.level === 'input' || e.level === 'result') return true;
    const f = dbgFilter.value;
    if(f === 'error') return e.level === 'error';
    if(f === 'warn') return e.level === 'error' || e.level === 'warn';
    if(f === 'net') return e.level === 'net';
    return true;
  }

  function lineEl(e){
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'dbg-line ' + e.level + (e.bad ? ' bad' : '');
    const ts = document.createElement('span');
    ts.className = 'ts';
    ts.textContent = timeStr(e.t);
    div.appendChild(ts);
    div.appendChild(document.createTextNode(e.text));
    return div;
  }

  function renderConsole(){
    dbgLog.innerHTML = '';
    let shown = 0;
    debugLog.forEach(e => { if(passesFilter(e)){ dbgLog.appendChild(lineEl(e)); shown++; } });
    dbgLogNote.textContent = shown + ' of ' + debugLog.length + ' lines';
    dbgLog.scrollTop = dbgLog.scrollHeight;
  }

  debugListener = (e) => {
    if(!debugPanel.classList.contains('open') || dbgTab !== 'console' || !passesFilter(e)) return;
    const nearBottom = dbgLog.scrollHeight - dbgLog.scrollTop - dbgLog.clientHeight < 60;
    dbgLog.appendChild(lineEl(e));
    if(nearBottom) dbgLog.scrollTop = dbgLog.scrollHeight;
  };

  dbgFilter.addEventListener('change', renderConsole);
  document.getElementById('btnDbgClear').addEventListener('click', () => { debugLog.length = 0; renderConsole(); });
  document.getElementById('btnDbgCopy').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const text = debugLog.map(e => timeStr(e.t) + ' [' + e.level + '] ' + e.text).join('\n');
    try{
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      dbgLogNote.textContent = 'copied ' + debugLog.length + ' lines';
    }catch(err){
      dbgLogNote.textContent = 'could not copy (browser blocked it)';
    }
  });

  function fmt(v){
    if(v === undefined) return 'undefined';
    if(typeof v === 'string') return JSON.stringify(v);
    if(typeof v === 'function') return String(v).slice(0, 300);
    try{ return JSON.stringify(v, null, 2); }catch(e){ return String(v); }
  }

  // tiny javascript console: runs in the page's global scope; use `lava` to reach the app's data
  document.getElementById('dbgEvalForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const code = dbgEvalInput.value.trim();
    if(!code) return;
    dbgEvalInput.value = '';
    pushLog('input', ['> ' + code]);
    try{
      let out = (0, eval)(code);
      if(out && typeof out.then === 'function') out = await out;
      pushLog('result', [fmt(out)]);
    }catch(err){
      pushLog('error', [err.message]);
    }
  });

  // ---- connectivity checks ----
  const ghHeaders = { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json' };
  const CHECK_NAMES = [
    'browser online', 'GitHub API + rate limit', 'repo + branch', 'file list + games',
    'jsDelivr CDN', 'shared edits file', 'Wikipedia (auto thumbnails)', 'GitHub token',
    'browser storage', 'password hashing'
  ];

  function buildChecks(ctx){
    return [
      async () => navigator.onLine
        ? { status: 'ok', detail: 'the browser says it is online' }
        : { status: 'bad', detail: 'the browser reports it is offline' },

      async () => {
        const r = await fetch('https://api.github.com/rate_limit', { headers: ghHeaders });
        if(!r.ok) return { status: 'bad', detail: 'HTTP ' + r.status };
        const j = await r.json();
        const c = (j.resources && j.resources.core) || j.rate;
        const left = c.remaining;
        return {
          status: left === 0 ? 'bad' : (left < 10 ? 'warn' : 'ok'),
          detail: left + ' of ' + c.limit + ' requests left this hour (resets ' + new Date(c.reset * 1000).toLocaleTimeString() + ')'
        };
      },

      async () => {
        const r = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/commits/${GH_BRANCH}`, { headers: ghHeaders });
        if(r.status === 404) return { status: 'bad', detail: `${GH_OWNER}/${GH_REPO} or branch "${GH_BRANCH}" not found (is the repo public?)` };
        if(!r.ok) return { status: 'bad', detail: 'HTTP ' + r.status };
        const j = await r.json();
        ctx.ref = j.sha;
        ctx.treeRef = j.commit.tree.sha;
        return { status: 'ok', detail: `${GH_BRANCH} is at ${j.sha.slice(0, 7)}: ${String(j.commit.message).split('\n')[0].slice(0, 80)}` };
      },

      async () => {
