        if(!ctx.treeRef) return { status: 'warn', detail: 'skipped (no commit found above)' };
        const r = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/git/trees/${ctx.treeRef}?recursive=1`, { headers: ghHeaders });
        if(!r.ok) return { status: 'bad', detail: 'HTTP ' + r.status };
        const j = await r.json();
        ctx.tree = j.tree || [];
        const files = ctx.tree.filter(t => t.type === 'blob').length;
        const games = buildGames(ctx.tree, ctx.ref).length;
        const notes = [];
        if(j.truncated) notes.push('file list was truncated, some games may be missing');
        if(games === 0) notes.push('no folder with an index.html found');
        return { status: notes.length ? 'warn' : 'ok', detail: `${files} files, ${games} games with an index.html` + (notes.length ? ' (' + notes.join('; ') + ')' : '') };
      },

      async () => {
        const g = activeGames[0];
        if(!g) return { status: 'warn', detail: 'no games loaded yet, open the games tab first' };
        const r = await fetch(g.playUrl, { method: 'HEAD' });
        return r.ok
          ? { status: 'ok', detail: `${g.id}/index.html reachable (HTTP ${r.status})` }
          : { status: 'bad', detail: `${g.id}/index.html returned HTTP ${r.status}` };
      },

      async () => {
        if(!ctx.tree) return { status: 'warn', detail: 'skipped (no file list above)' };
        if(!ctx.tree.some(t => t.type === 'blob' && t.path === OVERRIDES_FILE)){
          return { status: 'ok', detail: OVERRIDES_FILE + ' does not exist yet (it is created the first time you save an edit)' };
        }
        const r = await fetch(cdnBase(ctx.ref) + OVERRIDES_FILE);
        if(!r.ok) return { status: 'bad', detail: 'HTTP ' + r.status };
        const j = await r.json();
        return { status: 'ok', detail: OVERRIDES_FILE + ' is valid, ' + Object.keys(j).length + ' game(s) edited' };
      },

      async () => {
        const r = await fetch('https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&meta=siteinfo&format=json&origin=*');
        return r.ok ? { status: 'ok', detail: 'reachable' } : { status: 'bad', detail: 'HTTP ' + r.status };
      },

      async () => {
        const t = getToken();
        if(!t) return { status: 'warn', detail: 'no token set, edits only save in this browser' };
        const r = await fetch(API_BASE, { headers: { ...ghHeaders, 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + t } });
        if(r.status === 401) return { status: 'bad', detail: 'token rejected or expired' };
        if(!r.ok) return { status: 'bad', detail: 'HTTP ' + r.status };
        const j = await r.json();
        if(!j.permissions) return { status: 'warn', detail: 'token accepted, but could not confirm it can write' };
        return j.permissions.push
          ? { status: 'ok', detail: 'token is valid and can write to the repo' }
          : { status: 'warn', detail: 'token is valid but cannot write here (needs contents: read and write on this repo)' };
      },

      async () => {
        localStorage.setItem('lava_debug_probe', '1');
        const ok = localStorage.getItem('lava_debug_probe') === '1';
        localStorage.removeItem('lava_debug_probe');
        if(!ok) return { status: 'bad', detail: 'could not read back what was written' };
        let bytes = 0;
        Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k => k.startsWith('lava_')).forEach(k => { bytes += k.length + (localStorage.getItem(k) || '').length; });
        return { status: 'ok', detail: 'works, lava data uses about ' + (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB' };
      },

      async () => (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.subtle)
        ? { status: 'ok', detail: 'available' }
        : { status: 'bad', detail: 'not available here (needs https or localhost), so the developer password will not work' }
    ];
  }

  function renderCheckRows(){
    dbgChecks.innerHTML = '';
    return CHECK_NAMES.map(name => {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'dbg-check';
      const dot = document.createElement('span');
      dot.className = 'dbg-dot';
      const box = document.createElement('div');
      const n = document.createElement('div');
      n.className = 'dbg-check-name';
      n.textContent = name;
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'dbg-check-detail';
      d.textContent = 'not run yet';
      box.appendChild(n); box.appendChild(d);
      row.appendChild(dot); row.appendChild(box);
      dbgChecks.appendChild(row);
      return { dot, d };
    });
  }

  let checksRunning = false;

  async function runChecks(){
    if(checksRunning) return [];
    checksRunning = true;
    const rows = renderCheckRows();
    const ctx = {};
    const fns = buildChecks(ctx);
    const results = [];
    const started = performance.now();
    dbgRunNote.textContent = 'running…';
    for(let i = 0; i < fns.length; i++){
      rows[i].d.textContent = 'checking…';
      const t = performance.now();
      let r;
      try{ r = await fns[i](); }
      catch(err){ r = { status: 'bad', detail: 'failed: ' + (err.message || err) + ' (blocked, offline or a network error)' }; }
      r.ms = Math.round(performance.now() - t);
      rows[i].dot.className = 'dbg-dot ' + r.status;
      rows[i].d.textContent = r.detail + '  ·  ' + r.ms + 'ms';
      results.push({ name: CHECK_NAMES[i], ...r });
      if(r.status !== 'ok') console.warn('[check] ' + CHECK_NAMES[i] + ': ' + r.detail);
    }
    const bad = results.filter(r => r.status === 'bad').length;
    const warn = results.filter(r => r.status === 'warn').length;
    dbgRunNote.textContent = `done in ${Math.round(performance.now() - started)}ms: ${bad} failed, ${warn} warnings`;
    console.info('[check] finished: ' + bad + ' failed, ' + warn + ' warnings');
    checksRunning = false;
    return results;
  }

  document.getElementById('btnDbgRun').addEventListener('click', runChecks);

  // ---- library view ----
  function thumbSource(g){
    if(g.thumbUrl && g.thumbUrl !== g.baseThumb) return 'edited';
    if(g.baseThumb) return 'repo / config';
    const a = autoThumbs[g.id];
    if(a && a.url) return 'auto' + (a.fit === 'icon' ? ' (favicon)' : '');
    if(a) return 'none found';
    return 'letters';
  }

  function renderLibrary(){
    let cachedAge = 'nothing saved';
    try{
      const c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY) || 'null');
      if(c) cachedAge = 'saved list is ' + Math.round((Date.now() - c.time) / 1000) + 's old (refreshes after 5 min)';
    }catch(e){}
    const m = activeGames[0] && activeGames[0].playUrl.match(/@([^/]+)\//);
    dbgLibSummary.textContent = `${activeGames.length} games · version ${m ? m[1].slice(0, 7) : '?'} · ${cachedAge} · ` +
      `${Object.keys(autoThumbs).length} auto-thumbnail lookups saved · ${Object.keys(localEdits).length} browser-only edits`;

    dbgLibTable.innerHTML = '';
    const head = document.createElement('tr');
    ['folder', 'name', 'thumbnail', 'plays from'].forEach(t => { const th = document.createElement('th'); th.textContent = t; head.appendChild(th); });
    dbgLibTable.appendChild(head);
    activeGames.forEach(g => {
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      [g.id, g.title === g.baseTitle ? g.title : g.title + ' (edited)', thumbSource(g), g.playUrl].forEach(t => {
        const td = document.createElement('td'); td.textContent = t; tr.appendChild(td);
      });
      dbgLibTable.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  document.getElementById('btnDbgRefresh').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try{ localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY); }catch(e){}
    console.info('[debug] refreshing library');
    await loadGames();
    renderLibrary();
  });
  document.getElementById('btnDbgClearThumbs').addEventListener('click', () => {
    autoThumbs = {};
    try{ localStorage.removeItem(AUTO_KEY); }catch(e){}
    console.info('[debug] cleared saved auto-thumbnail lookups');
    renderGames(gamesSearch.value);
    renderLibrary();
  });
  document.getElementById('btnDbgClearLocal').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if(!confirm('Remove name/thumbnail edits saved only in this browser?')) return;
    localEdits = {};
    saveLocalEdits();
    console.info('[debug] cleared browser-only edits');
    refreshGames();
    renderLibrary();
  });
  document.getElementById('btnDbgClearAll').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if(!confirm('Clear the saved game list and thumbnail lookups? (your settings, token and edits are kept)')) return;
    try{ localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY); localStorage.removeItem(AUTO_KEY); }catch(e){}
    autoThumbs = {};
    console.info('[debug] cleared cached data');
    renderLibrary();
  });

  // ---- panel + tabs ----
  function showDbgTab(tab){
    dbgTab = tab;
    document.querySelectorAll('.dbg-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.tab === tab));
    document.getElementById('dbgViewConsole').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'console');
    document.getElementById('dbgViewConnect').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'connect');
    document.getElementById('dbgViewLibrary').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'library');
    if(tab === 'console') renderConsole();
    if(tab === 'library') renderLibrary();
    if(tab === 'connect' && !dbgChecks.children.length) renderCheckRows();
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.dbg-tab').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => showDbgTab(b.dataset.tab)));

  navDebug.addEventListener('click', () => {
    closeAllPanels();
    debugPanel.classList.add('open');
    setActiveNav('debug');
    showDbgTab(dbgTab);
  });
  document.getElementById('btnCloseDebug').addEventListener('click', () => {
    debugPanel.classList.remove('open');
    setActiveNav('home');
  });

  // `lava` in the console tab (or the browser's own console) reaches the app's data
  function debugHandle(){
    return {
      get games(){ return activeGames; },
      get raw(){ return rawGames; },
      get settings(){ return settings; },
      get localEdits(){ return localEdits; },
      get autoThumbs(){ return autoThumbs; },
      get log(){ return debugLog; },
      loadGames,
      redraw: () => renderGames(gamesSearch.value),
      checks: runChecks,
      clearCache(){ localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY); localStorage.removeItem(AUTO_KEY); return 'cleared'; }
    };
  }

  function onDevModeChange(on){
    if(on){
      window.lava = debugHandle();
      console.info('[debug] developer mode on. Try: lava.games, lava.checks(), lava.clearCache()');
    } else {
      delete window.lava;
      if(debugPanel.classList.contains('open')){
        closeAllPanels();
        setActiveNav('home');
      }
    }
  }

  // restore developer mode for this tab session (must run after everything above is set up)
  try{ if(sessionStorage.getItem(DEV_SESSION_KEY) === '1' && effectiveHash()) setDevMode(true); }catch(e){}
})();
</script>
  </body>
</html>
